categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Ruixinchang Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial precision aluminum alloy parts and components manufacturing. Its main business segments include electrical automation equipment components, automotive lightweight and thermal management system parts, and clean energy-related aluminum alloy parts. The company serves industries such as industrial automation, automotive (both traditional and new energy vehicles), and clean energy sectors including wind power, photovoltaic, and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical extrusion forming, mechanical bonding, welding, and CNC machining for manufacturing aluminum alloy heat sinks and precision parts. It employs multiple heat sink manufacturing technologies including integral extrusion, pressing, insertion, folding, copper-aluminum composite, heat pipe, and liquid cooling. The production process integrates mold design, tooling, and flexible automated production lines to deliver customized, high-precision aluminum alloy components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global industrial automation brands such as ABB, Schneider Electric, Siemens, Danfoss, Rockwell, and Vestas, as well as major automotive manufacturers like Toyota, Honda, Geely, Volvo, Audi, BMW, and BYD. The company targets high-end industrial automation, automotive lightweighting and thermal management, and clean energy equipment markets, focusing on providing customized aluminum alloy solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Tianjin and Changshu, and has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Thailand to serve international markets. Domestic sales account for over 80% of revenue, with international sales comprising approximately 19%. The overseas facilities support export business and mitigate tariff risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ruixinchang operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of precision aluminum alloy components and heat sinks. It procures raw aluminum alloy billets from upstream suppliers and supplies finished components directly to downstream industrial equipment manufacturers and automotive OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation and R&D in advanced aluminum alloys for new energy vehicles, high-efficiency heat dissipation materials for clean energy applications, and manufacturing process improvements such as cold forging and CNC machining. It invests in developing 6-series and 7-series aluminum alloys for automotive lightweighting and thermal management, and expands flexible automated production capabilities. Collaboration with universities and industry partners supports continuous innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized aluminum alloy components and heat sinks to industrial and automotive customers. Pricing is based on a 'benchmark aluminum price plus processing fee' model, with adjustments linked to market aluminum prices. The company operates on an order-driven production model, fulfilling customer-specific design and volume requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ruixinchang is positioned as a leading domestic high-tech enterprise in precision aluminum alloy parts manufacturing, with strong market share in electrical automation heat sinks and automotive lightweight components. It competes with global and domestic suppliers in industrial automation and automotive sectors, leveraging advanced technology, flexible production, and strategic partnerships with top-tier customers to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 622 million, a 6.42% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 55.3 million, down 26.62%. The company has total assets of about RMB 854 million and equity of RMB 800 million. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to macroeconomic challenges and reduced orders, the company continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D, including overseas production facilities, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ruixinchang offers highly customized, precision-engineered aluminum alloy components with superior mechanical, corrosion resistance, and thermal dissipation properties. Its one-stop service integrates material design, mold development, and flexible automated manufacturing, enabling rapid response to customer needs. The company’s advanced manufacturing technologies and strong quality management systems ensure high product reliability, supporting customers in industrial automation, automotive lightweighting, and clean energy sectors to improve efficiency and performance.
